title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Company: Zelandium LLP

Location: Remote

Duration: Up to 6 Months

Stipend: Unpaid

Working Hours: 6 hours per day (flexible)

Candidate Preference:
**Malayalam-speaking candidates**
, particularly those from Kerala, are preferred.

**About Zelandium**

**Zelandium**
is an eCommerce technology company that helps businesses build, transform, and scale modern online stores. Our services include store development, custom platforms, API and headless commerce, payment and shipping integrations, cloud deployment, performance optimization, analytics, and automation. We focus on delivering secure, scalable, and reliable eCommerce solutions that help businesses grow.

**Role Description**

* This remote Digital Marketing Intern role offers hands-on experience supporting marketing initiatives for Zelandium’s eCommerce technology solutions.
* The intern will assist in planning, executing, and monitoring digital campaigns across social media, email, and other online channels.
* Day-to-day tasks include creating and scheduling social media content, supporting online marketing activities, and helping maintain consistent brand messaging.
* The intern will also help track campaign performance using web analytics tools, compile reports, and suggest data-driven improvements.
* This is an internship role designed to build practical skills in digital marketing while collaborating closely with the marketing and product teams in a remote environment.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Social Media Marketing and Online Marketing to support campaign planning and content execution.
* Candidates should possess skills in Digital Marketing and Web Analytics to analyze performance and optimize campaigns.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively and create clear, engaging content.
* Basic understanding of eCommerce platforms or interest in eCommerce technology is beneficial.
* Familiarity with common marketing tools (e.g., social media schedulers, email marketing platforms, analytics dashboards) is an advantage.
* Current enrollment in, or recent completion of, a degree program in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and learn new tools and concepts quickly.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Hands-on experience in digital marketing
* Exposure to real startup marketing activities
* Experience working with a remote team
* Opportunity to build your portfolio
* Practical understanding of content, social media, SEO, and digital campaigns

If you’re looking for an opportunity to
**learn, experiment, create, and grow**
, we’d love to hear from you!

📩
**Interested? Apply now or send your CV to career@zelandium.com**

Know someone who would be a great fit?
**Tag them below or share this post!**
👇

title: Social Media Marketing Manager
description:
Hiring: Social Media Manager (Work From Home)

**Position:**
Social Media Manager

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
Remote / Work From Home

**Salary:**
₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month

**Experience:**
1–2 years

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, proactive, and execution-focused Social Media Manager to manage our agency and client social media accounts. The ideal candidate should understand content creation, reels, current trends, and social media growth strategies. We need someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, and focuses on results rather than simply posting content.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage Instagram, Facebook, and other social media platforms for multiple brands.
* Plan and execute monthly content calendars.
* Create engaging posts, captions, stories, and reels based on trends and brand objectives.
* Shoot and edit short-form videos and reels when required.
* Coordinate with designers and the performance marketing team.
* Monitor engagement, follower growth, reach, and overall account performance.
* Prepare monthly social media performance reports.
* Manage DMs, comments, and online community engagement.
* Stay updated with the latest social media trends and proactively implement new ideas.
* Take ownership of assigned accounts and ensure timely execution of tasks.

Requirements

* 1–2 years of experience in social media management.
* **Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.**
* Ability to understand and communicate in Malayalam.
* Strong content creation, copywriting, and storytelling skills.
* Basic video editing knowledge using CapCut, InShot, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.
* Good understanding of Instagram Reels, short-form video content, and engagement strategies.
* Strong time management, organization, and deadline management skills.
* A proactive attitude with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Ability to take initiative, suggest creative ideas, solve problems, and deliver results without constant supervision.

Good to Have

* Experience working with a digital marketing agency or multiple client accounts.
* A portfolio showcasing successful social media campaigns or high-performing reels.
* Basic design skills using Canva or Photoshop.
* Knowledge of social media advertising and performance marketing.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who is self-driven, creative, accountable, and passionate about social media. Since this is a work-from-home role,
**proactiveness, ownership, and professional English communication are essential.**

* If you can turn creative ideas into engaging content and help brands grow online, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sales And Marketing Specialist

* Candidates should possess the ability to work in a hybrid model, with reliable availability for on-site work in Dadri and occasional extended hours when required.

title: Senior Omnichannel Experience Design & Channel Manager
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
Lead the design, execution, and optimization of omnichannel engagement strategies that enhance HCP experience, improve commercial effectiveness, and drive measurable business outcomes. The role will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Medical, and Commercial Excellence teams to translate business priorities into impactful customer journeys and scalable omnichannel programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Omnichannel Strategy & Experience Design**

* Define and evolve omnichannel engagement frameworks aligned to business priorities.
* Design customer-centric journeys using HCP insights, channel preferences, and engagement data.
* Drive personalization, segmentation, and next-best-action initiatives.

**Campaign Planning & Orchestration**

* Translate brand objectives into integrated omnichannel campaigns.
* Ensure seamless orchestration across field, digital, events, remote engagement, and content channels.
* Drive campaign reviews and continuous optimization based on performance insights.

**Analytics & Performance Management**

* Generate actionable insights from customer behavior, channel performance, and campaign outcomes.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive execution of optimization plans.

**Channel & Capability Excellence**

* Lead deployment of new engagement capabilities, tools, and ways of working.
* Partner with global and local stakeholders to bring best practices and innovation into the market.

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Act as a strategic partner to Brand, Sales, Medical, and Leadership teams.
* Manage cross-functional priorities and ensure delivery excellence.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8-12 years in Omnichannel, Digital Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Customer Experience, CRM, or Analytics.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills.
* Experience in Pharma, Healthcare, or other customer-centric industries preferred.

**Critical Competencies**

* Customer Centricity
* Strategic Thinking
* Data & Analytics Mindset
* Execution Excellence
* Cross-functional Influence
* Digital Innovation
* People Leadership
* Culture Ambassador

**Skills**
Business Acumen, Customer Experience (CX), Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Digital Marketing, Product Lifecycle, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Business Manager
description:

 :
   

  

  

 The Business Manager is responsible for overseeing the business operations within the assigned region. This role involves managing a team of employees and consultants, achieving profitability goals, and ensuring efficient operations. The Business Manager collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external customers to drive growth, execute strategic plans, and ensure compliance with, LEGAL, regulatory and quality standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, market development, and key account management, with a focus on driving sustainable, profitable growth. Additional knowledge and experience on product registration will be preferred.
 


  


**Role Responsibilities** 
 :
 


  

  
* Achieve annual profitability goals by managing the regional team, portfolio, and strategy, reflected in the region's P\&L.

 • Proven experience managing key accounts and customers, with a track record of successful contract negotiations, A/R CONTROL and strategic partnerships.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 We are looking for a data\-driven, strategic, and hands\-on
 **Demand Generation Manager** 
 to lead our customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies. In this role, you will own multi\-channel campaigns designed to create, capture, and convert qualified pipeline for our sales teams.
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between marketing execution and sales velocity, partnering directly with Revenue Operations, Account Executives, and SDR leads to accelerate funnel conversion and maximize lifetime target account value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Campaign Strategy \& Execution: Design, build, and optimize multi\-channel inbound and outbound marketing campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, content syndication, webinars, and automated email sequences.
* Account\-Based Marketing (ABM): Partner closely with sales leads to execute tailored ABM strategies targeting our Target Account List (TAL) to increase enterprise deal velocity and win rates.
* Sales \& SDR Alignment: Build tight hand\-off processes and SLAs with the sales team to ensure rapid lead follow\-up, high conversion rates, and continuous feedback loops on lead quality.
* Funnel Analytics \& Attribution: Track, analyze, and present performance metrics across every stage of the funnel (MQLs, SQLs, CAC, ROAS, sales pipeline generated, and closed\-won revenue).
* MarTech \& Automation: Manage and optimize our core marketing stack (CRM, Marketing Automation, ABM tools) for precise audience segmentation, automated nurture tracks, and lead scoring.
* Experimentation \& Optimization: Continuously test ad creative, landing pages, copy, and audience targeting to lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) while scaling pipeline volume.


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience: 8\-10 years of hands\-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Channel Mastery: Proven track record managing significant monthly paid acquisition budgets ($30k\+/month) with verifiable pipeline contribution.
* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).
* Sales\-Minded Alignment: Strong empathy for sales workflows with a clear understanding of enterprise sales cycles, deal stages, and ACV dynamics.
* Data\-Driven: Ability to extract actionable insights from raw performance data and communicate key metrics clearly to executive leadership.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Program Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a Senior Integrated Marketing Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of our most important marketing programs from one of our India office locations. This role leads integrated campaigns and go\-to\-market initiatives that build brand visibility, generate pipeline, and support product and segment growth.
   

  

 You will be marketing leadership’s trusted planning partner — turning priorities into operating cadences, decision\-ready materials, and clear owners, milestones, and outcomes.
   

  

 You will co\-own execution alongside functional leads across brand, product marketing, web, demand generation, events, and marketing operations, bringing the programmatic rigor that keeps complex work on track. Beyond individual programs, you will help define how marketing operates together, establishing the operating model, cadences, and ways of working that scale as the team grows.
   

  

 This is a senior role with direct exposure to the marketing senior leadership team. You will also serve as a senior leader within the India marketing operations team, partnering closely with the US\-based Marketing Operations lead and the US\-based process and program management counterpart.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Program Planning \& Delivery**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake and planning through launch, measurement, and optimization.
* Translate business and marketing priorities into integrated roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency maps, and risk registers.
* Co\-own execution alongside functional leads, partnering with product marketing on launches, brand on creative delivery, and demand generation on campaign activation.
* Ensure campaign briefs, objectives, audience definitions, content requirements, channel plans, measurement plans, and launch criteria are agreed before work enters execution.
* Manage portfolio\-level visibility across concurrent programs, including prioritization, capacity trade\-offs, escalation, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Own the integrated marketing calendar as the shared view of what marketing is delivering and when, using it to drive sequencing, prioritization, and capacity conversations.


**Operating Cadence \& Governance**
* Build and run the operating cadences that keep priorities, risks, dependencies, and next steps visible, including status reviews, planning cycles, and launch readiness forums.
* Help define how marketing operates together — establishing the operating model, rituals, and ways of working that scale as the team and its remit grow.
* Improve intake, prioritization, approval, and launch governance processes, and build the templates, checklists, and standards that make delivery repeatable.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment, ensuring decisions, scope changes, approvals, and dependencies are documented, communicated, and resolved.
* Keep planning tools and the marketing calendar current and trusted, so conflicts, gaps, and over\-commitment surface before they affect delivery.


**Executive Engagement \& Reporting**
* Partner directly with the marketing senior leadership team on planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions, and bring forward the information they need to decide.
* Synthesize inputs from marketing, sales, product, and agency stakeholders into decision\-ready briefings and reporting for leadership.
* Provide executive\-ready visibility into program health, launch readiness, risks, blockers, trade\-offs, and decisions required.
* Partner with marketing operations and analytics to ensure tracking, measurement plans, and success metrics are defined and operational before launch.
* Communicate clearly and concisely with senior leaders, simplifying complex workstreams and presenting trade\-offs rather than escalating problems without options.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Serve as a senior leader within the India marketing operations team, providing direction, review, and coaching to other team members and raising the standard of delivery across the group.
* Be accountable for the quality, timeliness, and consistency of the programs the India team delivers.
* Coordinate closely with the US\-based Marketing Operations lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Partner with the US\-based process and program management counterpart to keep standards, templates, and ways of working consistent across regions.
* Build capability that outlasts any one individual — success is measured not only by what you deliver, but by how well the team can deliver without you.
* Apply AI tools practically to accelerate briefs, status reporting, documentation, and synthesis, and help the team adopt them in day\-to\-day ways of working.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and decision\-making.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 10\+ years of experience in marketing program or project management, integrated campaign delivery, or marketing operations, including significant time at a senior level.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-channel marketing programs in a fast\-paced B2B environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions.
* Experience running an integrated marketing calendar or equivalent planning system across multiple teams and channels.
* Experience working directly with senior marketing leadership on planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions.
* Strong working knowledge of how marketing moves from brief to content creation, channel activation, launch, and performance reporting.
* Practical fluency across core marketing channels, including email, web, webinars, events, paid media, organic social, and ABM programs.
* Experience overseeing delivery of marketing content such as emails, landing pages, ads, case studies, videos, event assets, and sales enablement materials.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, present trade\-offs, and escalate risks with recommendations.
* Experience establishing or improving marketing execution processes, intake models, and governance cadences.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* PMP, agile, or equivalent program management certification is preferred.
* Experience in technology, financial services, SaaS, or other complex enterprise go\-to\-market environments is preferred.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and work management platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or Workfront.
* Experience leading ABM or account\-focused programs, including target account prioritization, sales alignment, and account\-level performance tracking.
* Experience managing external agencies, media partners, freelancers, or offshore and shared\-services delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of campaign measurement, including engagement and conversion metrics, pipeline influence, attribution, and funnel movement.
* Experience building a new team, function, or delivery model from the ground up is a strong plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**How Success Will Be Measured**
*The measures this role will be held to*
**Measure**
**What Good Looks Like**
**On\-time delivery**
 High\-priority marketing programs and campaign launches delivered on schedule and within agreed scope.
   

  

**Program cycle time**
 Time from intake to launch reduces as intake, briefing, and approval processes mature.
   

  

**Launch readiness \& quality**
 Deliverables meet quality expectations with reduced rework and fewer late\-stage surprises.
   

  

**Stakeholder satisfaction**
 Marketing leadership and functional partners rate planning and program support as reliable and valuable.
   

  

**Executive visibility**
 Leaders consistently have clear, current insight into the marketing calendar, program health, risks, and decisions required.
   

  

**Operating model maturity**
 Execution processes become more scalable, documented, and repeatable, with less dependency on any one person.
   

  

**Business impact**
 Program delivery supports measurable improvement in audience engagement, pipeline contribution, and campaign velocity.
   

  

**What Will Make You Successful**
* Comfort leading through influence and shared ownership rather than relying on positional authority.
* The instinct to bring structure to ambiguity without adding bureaucracy for its own sake.
* Confidence and composure in front of senior leaders, including when the news is difficult.
* Judgment about what genuinely needs escalating, and what you should simply resolve.
* Credibility with specialists — enough marketing depth to ask the right questions and challenge constructively.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  


  
 


  



 One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  


  
 


  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  


  
 


  



 JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"
 



  


  
 


  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Major Account Manager - Conglomerates
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 Working together with a Solutions Consultant,, you will be responsible for growing your territory. You are the primary point\-of\-contact for India’s one of the largest conglomerate group and are accountable for delivering above quota sales performance in your region. You are motivated by a hunger to solve critically difficult challenges that face our clients. You develop trusted relationships at a high, executive level, focusing on the strategic nature of the partnership. This means that you have a concrete understanding of our product suites, and are able to help identify areas that can be resolved by Palo Alto Networks solutions.
   

  

 You will lead to identifying and signing appropriate channel partners as well as training them on our solutions. Additionally, your credibility will guide your customers in their search to transition to a more secure online environment. You feel empowered by our product offerings \- and love a technical challenge.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* You will specifically be responsible for managing a strategic Conglomerate group
* Employing world\-class account management skills to identify cross\-selling and up\-selling opportunities within the target accounts
* Be a highly competent presenter, with a proven track record in selling to C level executives
* Develop and maintain detailed account profiles including organisational charts for all accounts to be reviewed by management on a quarterly basis
* Facilitate communication on strategic and tactical issues facing our clients and partners
* Maintain continuity and up\-to\-date knowledge of industry trends, technical developments, and governmental regulations that affect target markets
* Develop market strategies and goals for each product and service; understand the strategies, goals, and objectives of accounts
* Lead coordinating account strategy and tactics for sales support team (inside sales, systems engineering, sales management)
* Take full responsibility for accurate sales forecasting by demonstrating in\-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through the procurement process
* Extensive domestic travel and possible International travel as necessary


**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Sales And Marketing Internship
description:
Sales \& Marketing Intern — 3\-Month Internship
 
**Company:** 
 Last Minutes Deal
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Remote
 



**Duration:** 
 3 Months
 



**Type:** 
 Unpaid Internship
 



**Suitable For:** 
 BBA, MBA, Marketing, Business, Hospitality \& related students/freshers
 


 About Last Minutes Deal
 
 Last Minutes Deal is a specialized platform for last\-minute stays, connecting travelers with nearby hotels, resorts, villas, camps, motels, and other accommodation options with last\-minute availability.
 



 The platform makes spontaneous travel easier by bringing relevant stay options together and simplifying the discovery, comparison, and booking experience.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for energetic and creative
 **Sales \& Marketing Interns** 
 who want practical exposure to how a growing travel and hospitality company builds its customer base, engages accommodation partners, and develops its brand.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on learning opportunity** 
 , where interns can work across
 **digital marketing, social media, content creation, video editing, influencer marketing, offline marketing, sales, lead generation, customer engagement, and market research** 
 .
 



 You will not be limited to theoretical marketing work—you will get an opportunity to participate in real business activities and understand how marketing and sales contribute to company growth.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Assist in planning and executing
 **online marketing campaigns** 
 .
* Support
 **social media marketing** 
 across relevant platforms.
* Help create engaging marketing content, posts, reels, stories, and promotional creatives.
* Assist with
 **short\-form video editing** 
 for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts and other digital channels.
* Research and identify relevant
 **influencers, creators, travel communities and collaboration opportunities** 
 .
* Support
 **influencer marketing and creator outreach** 
 initiatives.
* Assist in developing and executing
 **offline marketing activities** 
 and local promotional initiatives.
* Identify potential customers, business leads and accommodation partners.
* Support
 **lead generation, prospecting and follow\-ups** 
 .
* Communicate with potential users and hospitality partners through appropriate channels.
* Assist with customer and partner feedback collection.
* Conduct basic
 **market and competitor research** 
 .
* Help identify new marketing opportunities across travel, hospitality and local markets.
* Track campaign activities, leads, responses and basic performance metrics.
* Work with the team on new ideas to improve
 **customer engagement and brand visibility** 
 .
* Participate in sales and marketing strategy discussions and learn how growth initiatives are planned and executed.


 Skills \& Qualifications
 * Students pursuing
 **BBA, MBA, Marketing, Business Management, Hospitality Management or related programs** 
 are encouraged to apply.
* Strong
 **verbal and written communication skills** 
 .
* Interest in
 **Sales, Marketing and Business Development** 
 .
* Interest or basic knowledge of
 **digital marketing and social media marketing** 
 .
* Basic understanding of
 **Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube or other social platforms** 
 .
* Interest in
 **video editing and content creation** 
 is preferred.
* Familiarity with tools such as
 **Canva, CapCut, VN, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar tools** 
 is an advantage.
* Interest in
 **influencer marketing, creator outreach and online campaigns** 
 .
* Willingness to participate in
 **offline marketing and field\-oriented initiatives when required** 
 .
* Customer\-focused approach with the ability to communicate professionally.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a
 **remote environment** 
 .
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to learn quickly, experiment with new ideas and take ownership of assigned tasks.


 What You Will Learn
 
 During the 3\-month internship, you will gain practical exposure to:
 


* Digital Marketing
* Social Media Marketing
* Content Marketing
* Video Editing
* Influencer \& Creator Marketing
* Online Campaigns
* Offline Marketing
* Lead Generation
* Sales \& Business Development
* Customer Engagement
* Hospitality \& Travel Marketing
* Market Research
* Brand Building
* Marketing Analytics \& Performance Tracking
* Sales Follow\-up \& Conversion Processes
* Startup Growth \& Execution


 Who Should Apply?
 
 This internship is suitable for students and freshers who want to go beyond classroom learning and understand how
 **sales and marketing work inside a growing startup** 
 .
 



 Students who are creative, communicative, curious, proactive and interested in
 **travel, hospitality, marketing, sales, social media or entrepreneurship** 
 are encouraged to apply.
 


 Internship Structure
 
**Duration:** 
 3 Months
 



**Mode:** 
 Remote
 



**Compensation:** 
 Unpaid Internship
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers and students are welcome
 



**Academic Background:** 
 BBA / MBA / Marketing / Business / Hospitality / Related Fields
 



 This internship is designed primarily around
 **practical learning, hands\-on execution and exposure to real startup sales and marketing activities** 
 .
 


 Ideal Candidate
 
 We are looking for someone who doesn't just want to
 *study marketing* 
 , but wants to
 **learn by doing it** 
 .
 


* If you enjoy creating content, talking to people, exploring marketing ideas, editing videos, discovering influencers, generating leads and understanding how a startup grows, this internship can provide a broad practical learning experience.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission passionately provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sri Madhusudan Sai, the organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Social Media Strategist role will involve crafting impactful campaigns that resonate with our values and vision. By staying abreast of the latest social media trends and technologies, you'll ensure our message reaches the right audience. Collaborating closely with our project and communications teams, you'll help manage our online reputation and leverage data\-driven insights to optimise our social media presence.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Transform our social media presence with groundbreaking strategies that resonate with our audience and powerfully convey our message.
* Collaborate closely with the project and communications teams to create cohesive and impactful social awareness strategies and campaigns.
* Demonstrate expertise in navigating and utilising major social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, and other popular apps.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest social media trends, technologies, and best practices to ensure the organisation maintains a strong online presence.
* Handle online reputation management and social listening activities to monitor the organisation's brand image and respond to discussions and inquiries.
* Leverage data analytics and insights to measure the performance of social media campaigns, identify opportunities for improvement, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Organise and host external events, such as community events and competitions, to further engage the organisation's online following.
* Continuously explore new and innovative ways to leverage social media to support the organisation's mission and objectives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, management, and content creation.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful social media campaigns.
* Familiarity with social media management tools and analytics platforms.
* Experience in event planning and community engagement is an added advantage.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Exceptional strategic and creative thinking skills to conceptualise and execute engaging social media campaigns.
* Proficiency in managing and leveraging major social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram.
* Strong understanding of social media trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Data\-driven approach to social media analytics and performance optimisation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate ideas and strategies.
* Proactive and adaptable mindset to respond to changing social media landscape.
* Project management skills and ability to work under tight deadlines.
* Creativity and passion for leveraging social media to drive organisational goals.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience in event planning and community engagement is an added advantage.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 This is a fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from home on a full\-time basis.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 32 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
